units: wh: withers-height units, withers at 0,0, y down, ground at y = 1; units: drawing units (same frame as the skeleton)

specific_tension_MPa.why: muscle force per cross-section area, to turn max isometric force into thickness (typical 0.25-0.3; estimate)

muscle_end.why: muscle thickness at its attachments, x its belly thickness (muscles taper into tendons and flat sheets; estimate)

hull_ratio.why: concave-hull tightness (0 tight, 1 convex); a drawing choice

smooth.why: outline smoothing radius, withers-height units (a drawing choice)

fur_chest.why: fur and skin below the sternum the photo chest depth includes, withers-height units (estimate; wolves have a belly ruff)

tail_width.why: tail half-width at base and tip, withers-height units (bone + muscle only; fur comes later; estimate)
